=== radarr without url or api key
args: radarr
env: (none)
url is required
api-key must be a 20-32 character alphanumeric string

=== radarr url with credentials
args: radarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 URL=http://user:pw@host:7878
url must not contain credentials; use API_KEY_FILE/API_KEY or form auth

=== radarr url with query
args: radarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 URL=http://host:7878/?apikey=x
url must not contain a query string

=== radarr short api key
args: radarr
env: API_KEY=short URL=http://host:7878
api-key must be a 20-32 character alphanumeric string

=== sonarr series concurrency zero
args: sonarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 SERIES_CONCURRENCY=0 URL=http://host:7878
series-concurrency must be between 1 and 32

=== sonarr series concurrency not a number
args: sonarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 SERIES_CONCURRENCY=abc URL=http://host:7878
env: parse error on field "SeriesConcurrency" of type "int": strconv.ParseInt: parsing "abc": invalid syntax

=== lidarr form auth without credentials
args: lidarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 FORM_AUTH=true URL=http://host:7878
auth-username and auth-password are required when form-auth is set

=== lidarr username without form auth
args: lidarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 AUTH_USERNAME=u URL=http://host:7878
auth-username/auth-password are only supported with form-auth (basic auth was removed)

=== prowlarr invalid backfill date from env
args: prowlarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 PROWLARR__BACKFILL_SINCE_DATE=2024-13-01 URL=http://host:7878
backfill-since-date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD

=== prowlarr invalid backfill date from flag
args: prowlarr --backfill-since-date 2024-13-01
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 URL=http://host:7878
backfill-since-date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD

=== bazarr series batch size zero
args: bazarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 BAZARR__SERIES_BATCH_SIZE=0 URL=http://host:7878
series-batch-size must be greater than zero

=== sabnzbd without api key
args: sabnzbd
env: URL=http://host:8080
api-key is required

=== sabnzbd url not absolute
args: sabnzbd
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 URL=not-a-url
url must be an absolute URL (scheme://host[:port][/path])

=== port zero
args: radarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 PORT=0 URL=http://host:7878
port is required

=== unknown log level
args: radarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 LOG_LEVEL=verbose URL=http://host:7878
log-level must be one of: debug, info, warn, error

=== unknown log format
args: radarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 LOG_FORMAT=xml URL=http://host:7878
log-format must be one of: console, json

=== interface not an ip
args: radarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 INTERFACE=not-an-ip URL=http://host:7878
interface must be a valid IP address: "not-an-ip"

=== scrape timeout zero
args: radarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 SCRAPE_TIMEOUT=0s URL=http://host:7878
scrape-timeout must be greater than zero

=== api key file missing
args: radarr
env: API_KEY_FILE=/nonexistent/exportarr-key URL=http://host:7878
env: could not load content of file "/nonexistent/exportarr-key" from variable API_KEY_FILE: open /nonexistent/exportarr-key: no such file or directory

=== sonarr unknown flag
args: sonarr --bogus
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 URL=http://host:7878
unknown flag: --bogus

=== every base setting invalid
args: radarr
env: API_KEY=abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789 INTERFACE=not-an-ip LOG_FORMAT=xml LOG_LEVEL=verbose PORT=0 SCRAPE_TIMEOUT=0s URL=http://host:7878
log-level must be one of: debug, info, warn, error
log-format must be one of: console, json
port is required
scrape-timeout must be greater than zero
interface must be a valid IP address: "not-an-ip"

=== base error before app error
args: radarr
env: PORT=0
port is required
